decisions.reason: As a newly launched software product close to our core offer and already given its own page, it remains a low-cost strategic option in a growing market and there is too little evidence after one year to justify abandonment.

Although only briefly mentioned so far, this archiving and reporting software is close to our established capabilities and should be kept because uncertainty about demand is still high while the cost of keeping the option open is likely modest.

This product builds on our established infrastructure offering and, having been launched only recently and presented prominently, should be retained until more market feedback reveals whether its value can be scaled.

The sludge extractor fits our existing water-engineering business, and in a growing industry with active R&D and broad product scope it is rational to keep this young option open rather than exit before uncertainty resolves.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is highly aligned with our strategic move toward connected and data-driven infrastructure solutions, so we should continue offering it while its commercial potential becomes clearer.
